w10_P4_000938: A test-cell supervisor needs the net energy figure, in joules, for one shift on the drop rig. The plunger's distance travelled along its guide is, in metres, 3*t^3 + 0*t^2 with t in seconds, and the cell is held at 22 degrees C throughout. The shift is scored at the instant t = 3 s, when a brake sleeve takes 10 m/s off the plunger's speed and it strikes the anvil at what remains. The plunger has a mass of 24 kg, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is the figure for a single strike. Each cell delivers 12 strikes, and the shift covers 8 identical cells. A standing instrument draw of 3 J is then subtracted from the shift's combined figure. What is the net figure, in J?
w10_P4_000941: A cable-drum test bench runs a loaded shuttle back and forth along a rail. The shuttle's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 9v + 20 = 0. The shuttle has a mass of 15 kg, and the energy it carries by virtue of its motion is logged for each pass. The bench makes 8 passes in a run, and the log expresses a run's total in kilojoules. The site operates 9 identical benches, and the company owns 9 identical sites. What total energy, in kJ, does the company have in motion at that moment?
w10_P4_000947: A quarry laboratory releases a runaway trolley down a sloped rail. The trolley's release speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 8v + 7 = 0. The trolley has a mass of 55000 g, and the rail is kept at 15 degrees C during the test. The energy the trolley carries by virtue of its motion at release is expressed in kilojoules, and the laboratory releases 3 identical trolleys in each test. A trigger spring contributes a further 1 kJ to the test's combined figure. The laboratory's fixed instrument allowance of 28 kJ is then subtracted. What is the laboratory's net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000948: A bottling plant needs the final entry, in kilojoules, on the energy sheet for one filling head. The head's ram is driven up to speed by 5 identical cam strokes, and each stroke contributes 7 m/s on the push and a further 4 m/s on the release. The ram has a mass of 2 kg and meets the cap at the accumulated speed. A seal absorbs 5 J from the ram's energy of motion at each impact. The head makes 9 impacts in a cycle, and the sheet expresses the cycle total in kilojoules. A metering valve then draws 4 kJ, which is subtracted from that figure. What is the final entry, in kJ?
w10_P4_000949: A rolling mill is commissioning a new entry guide. The guide carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 13a + 40 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 48000 g, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A pre-load screw adds a constant 1 N to that force, and the commissioning sheet expresses the result in kilonewtons. One stand carries 12 identical carriages, and the mill has 6 identical stands. What total force, in kN, does the mill's entry section carry?
w10_P4_000961: A wind-tunnel team needs the final stored figure, in kilojoules, for one launch sequence. The launcher builds the model's speed with 3 identical cartridges, and each cartridge contributes 4 m/s while it burns and a further 17 m/s while it vents. The model has a mass of 29 kg, and the tunnel air is held at 20 degrees C. A pre-charged latch holds 29 J, which is added to the energy the model carries by virtue of its motion at launch. The sum is expressed in kilojoules, and the team performs 6 identical launches. What is the final stored figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000971: A press manufacturer wants the final logged figure, in joules, from a punch trial. The punch's travel along its guide is, in metres, 5*t^3 - 6*t^2 with t in seconds, and the workshop is held at 34 degrees C. The trial is scored at the instant t = 2 s, when the punch has a mass of 21 kg and moves at whatever speed its travel curve then gives. A latch spring contributes a further 15 J on top of the energy the punch carries by virtue of that motion. The trial fires 7 identical punches, a fixed instrument loss of 19 J is subtracted from their combined figure, and a calibration source then adds 24 J. What is the final logged figure, in J?
w10_P4_000973: A conveyor supplier holds 7 different roller types in stock and must fit 4 of them to a trial belt. The engineer first counts the number of distinct sets of 4 roller types that could be drawn from the 7. Of those sets, 3 are rejected because they mix incompatible bearings. The trial sled is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to the number of sets still allowed. The sled has a mass of 31000 g, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. The supplier runs 4 identical trial sleds together. What total energy, in kJ, do the sleds carry?
w10_P4_000974: A laboratory wants the total energy, in kilojoules, held by a bank of test carriages. The bench has 7 sensor ports, each carriage uses a distinct choice of 4 of those ports, and the controller sets a carriage's speed in metres per second numerically equal to the number of distinct choices available. Each carriage has a mass of 20000 g, and the bench is kept at 19 degrees C. The energy one carriage carries by virtue of its motion is multiplied by the 12 carriages in a rack, and the rack's figure is expressed in kilojoules. The laboratory runs 8 identical racks. What total energy, in kJ, does the laboratory hold?
w10_P4_000975: A haulage firm is rating a new trailer brake rig. The rig builds its retardation in 2 identical phases, and each phase contributes 9 m/s^2 while the shoes bite and a further 13 m/s^2 while they lock, so the trailer's overall rate of change of speed is the accumulated figure. The trailer has a mass of 148 kg, and the rig must apply exactly the force that produces that motion. Each rig tests 2 trailers side by side, every depot runs 11 such rigs, and the firm has 10 identical depots. What total force, in kN, does the firm's fleet of rigs apply?
w10_P4_000976: A shipyard needs the total pull, in kilonewtons, from one winch bank. Each winch drum spins up in 4 identical stages, and every stage contributes 6 m/s^2 while the clutch engages and a further 7 m/s^2 while it drives, giving the drum carriage's overall rate of change of speed. The carriage has a mass of 113 kg, and a winch supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. Every frame carries 2 such carriages, so a frame's load is 2 times a single carriage's force, and a fixed rigging pre-load of 12 N is then added to each frame. The bank contains 11 identical frames. What total pull, in kN, does the bank carry?
w10_P4_000982: A power-tool maker wants the total thrust, in newtons, from a whole test rack. Each test jig has 13 mounting holes, and the jig is set so that its carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is numerically equal to the number of distinct pairs of holes a brace could join. The carriage has a mass of 145 kg, and each jig supplies exactly the force that produces the carriage's motion. A rack holds 6 identical jigs, and a fixed frame relief of 26 N is taken off the rack's combined force. The maker operates 10 identical racks. What total thrust, in N, do the racks deliver?
w10_P4_000984: A gearbox workshop needs the net stored figure, in kilojoules, for one afternoon. Two index wheels on the bench carry 292 teeth and 363 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both tooth counts exactly. The test slider is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number; it has a mass of 50 kg, and the bench is held at 17 degrees C. The energy the slider carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the bench runs 9 sliders at a time. The afternoon covers 6 identical sessions, and a standing instrument draw of 19 kJ is then subtracted from the total. What is the net stored figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000994: A steelworks is commissioning a tilting-table drive. The table's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 11a + 24 = 0. The table has a mass of 169 kg, the pit below it is kept at 28 degrees C, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. The commissioning sheet expresses that force in kilonewtons. A hydraulic pre-load adds 26 kN and a counterweight chain adds a further 7 kN to the sheet's figure. A guide roller then relieves 19 kN of the total. What figure, in kN, goes on the commissioning sheet?
w10_P4_001006: A theme-park engineer is checking a launch car on a straight section of track. The car's launch speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 7v + 6 = 0. The car has a mass of 21000 g, and the track surface is at 26 degrees C on the day of the test. The engineer measures the energy the car carries by virtue of its motion and multiplies it by the 3 cars that launch together. From that combined figure 24 J is deducted for the launch-fin drag, and the result is expressed in kilojoules. The park operates 2 identical launch tracks. What total energy, in kJ, do the park's tracks hold at launch?
w10_P4_001007: A foundry crane's hoist is being rated. The hoist carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying a^2 - 13a + 40 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 100000 g, and the motor supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A counterweight relieves 14 N of that force. Each hoist frame carries 9 identical carriages, each bay holds 2 frames, and the foundry has 7 identical bays. What total force, in N, do the foundry's hoists supply?
w10_P4_001016: A laboratory needs the final figure, in kilojoules, for a sled trial. The sled's position along its rail is, in metres, 1*t^3 - 2*t^2 with t in seconds, and the hall is kept at 18 degrees C. The trial is scored at the instant t = 4 s, when the sled has a mass of 4 kg and moves at whatever speed its position curve then gives. The energy the sled carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the laboratory runs 8 identical sleds. A fixed rig overhead of 16 kJ is subtracted from the combined figure, and the whole trial is repeated on 7 identical days. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001025: A hydraulics team needs the final total, in kilojoules, from a week of ram tests. The ram's release speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 5*x^2 + 0*x between x = 1 and x = 3, where x is the valve-lift index. The ram has a mass of 38000 g, the oil is held at 46 degrees C, and the energy the ram carries by virtue of its motion at release is expressed in kilojoules. A standing rig overhead of 26 kJ is subtracted from that figure. The team performs 5 releases per day and tests on 5 identical days. What is the final total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001027: A cycle-testing bench accelerates a dummy rider along a short rail. The rail's base speed b, in m/s, is the smaller value that satisfies b^2 - 6*b + 5 = 0, and a tail fan then adds a further 14 m/s, so the dummy leaves the rail at the combined speed. The dummy has a mass of 44000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is measured at the end of the rail. A pre-charged latch contributes a further 18 J to the reading. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001028: A ballistics bench needs the final corrected reading, in joules, from a single shot. The projectile's muzzle speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 2*x^2 + 3*x between x = 1 and x = 4, where x is the barrel-station index, and the range hut sits at 12 degrees C. The projectile has a mass of 2 kg and carries the energy of motion that this speed implies. The instrument then subtracts 2 J for the sabot and a further 26 J for the muzzle blast. A calibration source finally adds 25 J to the reading. What is the final corrected reading, in J?
w10_P4_001035: A tunnelling machine's thrust ring is being rated. The ring's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the sum of the whole numbers from 1 up to 5, one for each of its numbered pressure stages. The moving ring has a mass of 142000 g, and the rams supply exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide shoe relieves 9 N of that force, and the rating sheet expresses the result in kilonewtons. The machine carries 9 identical thrust rings. What total thrust, in kN, does the machine's rating sheet show?
w10_P4_001037: A model-rocket club is instrumenting a powered launch rail. The rail carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying a^2 - 12a + 32 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 8000 g, and the rail motor supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide spring adds 19 N to the motor's load, a retaining clip adds a further 13 N, and a launch lug adds another 9 N. What total load, in N, does the rail motor carry?
w10_P4_001039: A robot arm's linear axis is being commissioned. The slide's speed along the axis is, in metres per second, 1*t^3 - 2*t^2 with t in seconds. The commissioning point is the instant t = 2 s, at which the slide has a mass of 125000 g and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the slide's rate of change of speed. The commissioning sheet expresses that force in kilonewtons. The cell contains 3 identical arms working together, and a fixed counterweight of 5 kN pulls against their combined effort. What net figure, in kN, goes on the sheet?
w10_P4_001040: A materials laboratory wants the final total, in kilojoules, from a fatigue campaign. The hammer's position along its guide is, in metres, 2*t^3 + 3*t^2 with t in seconds, and the campaign is scored at the instant t = 2 s. At that instant the hammer has a mass of 25 kg and moves at whatever speed its position curve gives. From the energy the hammer carries by virtue of that motion, 30 J is subtracted for guide friction, and the corrected figure is expressed in kilojoules. The rig strikes 8 times in a cycle, and the campaign covers 12 identical cycles. What is the final total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001046: A dockside gantry is being load-tested. The gantry trolley builds its rate of change of speed in 3 identical steps, and each step contributes 2 m/s^2 as the clutch takes up and a further 2 m/s^2 as it drives. The trolley has a mass of 91 kg, the machinery house is kept at 23 degrees C, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce the trolley's motion. Each gantry runs 4 identical trolleys, and the load-test sheet expresses a gantry's combined force in kilonewtons. The dock has 6 identical gantries. What total force, in kN, does the dock's gantry fleet apply?
